items.title: Privacy egress monitor
items.summary: Live tracking of what certified/legitimate apps actually send — moving CounterSpy from 'is this spyware?' to 'this app is trusted, but here's what it's exfiltrating; do you consent?'. A per-process egress observer (destination/volume tracking, consent deltas). Rationale: the v0.3.0 feedback loop measures false positives among flagged apps; the next risk surface is the apps NOT flagged — notarized/allowlisted software that over-collects. Rhymes with the egress-only invariant: watch egress because egress is where the risk lives.
